statement: Take the quest from NPC lafu sheep first or you will be soft locked; do nothing until the quest says to.
Seed planting quest: plant a seed by clicking the compost bag next to the crops to open the farming UI.
The compost bag UI has four options: seed type (default seed at start) and collect all (harvests all ready plants) plus others.
Handyman tools menu is where you plant your first seed by clicking open soil plot; this completes the first quest.
Second quest: buy a land plot and harvest two apples; once you have two apples you can buy your first plot.
Crop info UI shows current plant
confidence: and percent chance for an evolution; apples are first evolution so ignore chance.

statement: You can lock plants in handyman tools so they don't evolve; use it to stockpile a specific plant.
First sneaking quest requires finding 100 Jade coins; pick up coins and hover on the floor to see Jade and XP rate.
Buy the upgrade looting ambition on the left under the Jade coin amount to unlock drops while sneaking.
Next quest step is to obtain chain nunchucks.
Equipped weapons act like modes; with no weapon equipped is searching mode which gets Jade coins
explicit: potential loot drops and sneaking XP.

statement: Nunchucks are for pushing to a new floor and attack doors; if no door they default to search mode.
When breaking doors you receive no XP
explicit: no Jade and no potential drops.

statement: Second floor has a tied-up friend; untie by equipping a kunai found by searching same floor; untying gives no XP
Recap: no weapon is searching mode
Next quest requires buying from the Jade Emporium left of the tower; it sells permanent bonuses using the same currency as the tower.
Last quests cover summoning: interact with chessboard for winner bonuses and career wins; click White Stone then find opponent to start a match.
Clicking the checkerboard drops slimes in that lane; spam the bottom lane to easily win the first match.
Matches get harder as you progress.
Second match requires buying upgrades first; click White Stone next to the chessboard; essence accrues slowly based on hourly rate in skill info.
Spend essence on slime damage or health; get just enough health to take an extra hit and enough attack to minimize hitting the opponent's army.
Start the second match and spam bottom lane again to finish the quest line.
Spirit lock on a portal with a number means you need that many characters to complete the kill count to continue.
